description:
Reid Osprey 2 | Road bike
Lightweight, responsive and built to go further – a versatile road bike designed for fitness riding, everyday road cycling and longer adventures.
The Reid Bikes Osprey 2 takes the Osprey road bike range to the next level, combining a lightweight aluminium frame with upgraded components for improved performance, comfort and control. Designed for riders looking to build their confidence on the road, improve their fitness or enjoy longer cycling adventures, it delivers an excellent balance of speed, reliability and value.
At its core is a lightweight aluminium frame with sculpted tubing, engineered to maximise pedalling efficiency and provide responsive handling when putting the power down. Internal cable routing and a tapered head tube create a clean, streamlined finish, while the full carbon fibre straight-blade fork helps reduce overall weight and absorb road vibrations for a smoother, more controlled ride. A 12mm front thru-axle further enhances front-end stiffness and stability.
An 18-speed LTWOO drivetrain provides a versatile range of gearing for tackling challenging climbs, maintaining speed on flatter roads and adapting to changing gradients. The compact 50/34T Prowheel alloy chainset is paired with an 11-32T cassette, offering a practical combination of climbing ability and efficient cruising. LTWOO integrated shifters provide precise, reliable gear changes, with ergonomic controls that keep shifting and braking conveniently within reach.
One of the key upgrades over the Osprey 1 is the addition of Tektro C310 mechanical disc brakes with 160mm rotors. Offering dependable stopping power and consistent braking performance in changing weather conditions, they provide greater confidence and control when navigating descents, wet roads and busy routes.
The Reid Bikes Osprey 2 rolls on 700c double-wall alloy wheels fitted with Kenda Kriterium 700x30mm tyres. Designed to balance rolling efficiency, grip and comfort, these road tyres provide a capable setup for everything from everyday cycling to longer distances. Compact alloy drop handlebars offer multiple hand positions to suit different riding conditions, while comfortable bar tape and a sport saddle help support a more enjoyable riding experience.
With its carbon fibre fork, upgraded drivetrain and disc brake technology, the Reid Osprey 2 offers a significant step up for riders looking for a more capable road bike. Whether you're building cycling fitness, exploring new routes or taking on longer weekend rides, it's designed to deliver responsive performance and reliable comfort mile after mile.
The Reid Bikes Osprey 2 is ideal for:

Road cycling and fitness riding, with a lightweight aluminium frame and responsive handling for regular training and recreational rides

Long-distance road cycling, with a carbon fibre fork designed to reduce road vibrations and improve comfort over longer rides

Tackling hills and varied gradients, with an 18-speed LTWOO drivetrain and compact 50/34T chainset

Faster road riding, with Kenda Kriterium 700x30mm tyres offering a balance of rolling efficiency, grip and comfort

Reliable all-weather braking, with Tektro mechanical disc brakes and 160mm rotors for controlled stopping in changing conditions

Responsive handling and stability, with a lightweight 6061 aluminium frame, tapered head tube and 12mm front thru-axle

Comfortable gear changes, with LTWOO integrated shifters providing convenient shifting and braking controls

Everyday road cycling and commuting, with practical gearing, durable components and a versatile road-focused setup

Riders progressing from an entry-level road bike, with upgraded components including a full carbon fibre fork and disc brakes

Weekend adventures and longer rides, combining lightweight construction, versatile gearing and dependable performance
